note: Revised from the species-level description in Chhotani (1997), originally in English; the original describes the soldier and the worker and records the alate as unknown. One figure for the soldier pronotal width was not recorded because of OCR damage (0..53), and synonymy lists, literature citations and distribution records have been omitted.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head yellowish brown, body straw yellow. Head sparsely setose. Total body length 4.2–4.52 mm. Head subrectangular, length to mandibular base 1.27–1.41 mm, maximum width 0.81–0.84 mm; transverse suture distinct. Fontanelle minute. Antennae 13-segmented; segment 2 equal to segments 3 and 4 together; segment 3 shortest. Labrum rounded pentagonal. Mandibles short, coarsely serrate, apex incurved. Pronotum saddle-shaped, about 0.52 mm wide.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Head pale yellowish brown; legs and body pale yellow. Head and body rather densely setose. Total body length 3.0–3.7 mm. Head subquadrate, length to mandibular base 0.67 mm, maximum width 0.68–0.72 mm. Fontanelle indistinct. Antennae 13-segmented; segment 2 equal to segments 3 and 4 together, segment 3 shortest. Postclypeus convex, longer than half its width. Pronotum saddle-shaped, length 0.22 mm, width 0.45–0.49 mm.
